scope: Public first-party X permalinks corroborated by press and separately attributed Meta/X press-discovery leads. All ten leaders, five subjects, 5 Aug–5 Nov 2026.
method: No covert browser evasion or bypass. An original permalink linked in a publisher is not necessarily an authenticated retrieved post; Facebook/Instagram individual originals remain unverified. Press leads are not counted as original platform posts. Six additional Baghel X URLs were cross-referenced to press articles and date-checkable X Snowflake IDs; the archive still does not represent a complete X timeline. Some reports contain attributed political claims that must not be interpreted as proven facts.
